Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

manifoldalign 0.1.0.9000

Major Changes

  • Implemented Fused-Partial Gromov-Wasserstein (FPGW) distance for heterogeneous domain adaptation
  • Added support for mass-constrained partial optimal transport with rho parameter

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed network simplex solver segfaults by improving error handling
  • Withdrew FPGW’s lambda > 0 penalized route. It selected balanced transport vertices, so transported mass remained one and the parameter could not solve partial FPGW; its line-search term also disagreed with the stated objective. Historical penalized results are invalid as partial-transport evidence. Use the oracle-verified fixed-mass rho route instead.
  • Fixed GlobalGeo spatial-anchor smoothness to use the declared adjoin dependency, count non-self neighbors correctly, preserve one-way kNN edges through union symmetrization, and expose a zero-penalty isolate policy.
  • Corrected the Linear Similarity Embedding similarity-gradient sign and scale, the orthogonality-gradient scale in both backends, and the C++ L-BFGS-B stopping control. Nonzero optimizer statuses now use a verified exact-objective fallback or stop; they no longer return an apparently valid fit. Historical LSE fits carrying a nonzero convergence code are invalid.
  • Withdrew validate_out_of_sample_reconstruction(), which previously returned expected_error plus random noise without fitting KEMA or evaluating held-out predictions. Historical values from this routine are invalid as accuracy evidence, and it is no longer included in run_kema_validation_suite().
  • Corrected KEMA component selection to solve on the numerical image of the kernel blocks and explicitly deflate graph-component null modes. KEMA now uses eigencore’s certified full or constrained generalized LOBPCG solver, requires a strictly positive metric regularizer, rejects materially negative modes, and independently checks residuals and B-orthogonality at 1e-6. Auto mode tries alternate backends and then stops if no backend passes; warning-only failed fits are no longer returned. Historical KEMA results with fidelity$passed == FALSE, or whose selected eigenvalues do not exceed their numerical-zero threshold, are invalid.

Deprecations and Warnings

  • Reclassified GlobalGeo, CONE-Align, and CONE-Align Multiple as legacy/reference rather than recommended or experimental methods. GlobalGeo completed 8/21 intended frozen cases and its partial-overlap claim is withdrawn pending a disconnected-landmark policy. Pairwise CONE completed 10/12; its two latent-dimension/Procrustes errors also gate the multiple-domain wrapper. These explicit failures are repair items, not silent wrong-result findings, so the methods are not deprecated solely for benchmark loss.
  • multiscale_manifold_align() is deprecated and scheduled for removal in manifoldalign 1.0.0. It completed only 19 of 40 frozen validation runs and its scaling fixtures fail with a malformed solver formula. Existing code is retained temporarily for reproducibility, but new work should use rapid_ma() for supplied relations/positions/attributes, ssma_align() for semi-supervised feature manifolds, or spectral_mnn_align() for an unsupervised spectral baseline.
  • FPGW’s lambda parameter is retained only for compatibility and must be zero. Calls with lambda > 0 now stop with a migration message directing users to the exact-mass rho formulation.
  • validate_out_of_sample_reconstruction() is now a compatibility shim that warns and stops. Use cv_alignment_rows() for leakage-safe held-out alignment scoring until KEMA has a verified OOS reconstruction predictor and oracle.
  • kema_orig() is deprecated in favor of the single public kema() entry point and is scheduled for removal in manifoldalign 1.0.0. solver = "regression" is withdrawn because it never selected a distinct regression implementation. Formerly ignored extension arguments (use_laplacian, dweight, rweight, simfun, disfun, and centre_kernel) now error instead of misrepresenting the fitted objective.
  • validate_kema_eigenvalues() is withdrawn: it did not reproduce a documented paper fixture and solved the wrong generalized right-hand side. Historical paper-eigenvalue validation results from that function are invalid.

Internal Changes

  • The unused partial_ot_tv() augmentation now stops instead of exposing an objective that was not the package’s documented FPGW penalty.
  • Partial FPGW warm starts are rescaled into the exact-rho subcoupling feasible set before Frank-Wolfe iterations; infeasible internal starts now fail explicitly.
  • Replaced the feature-cloud-only graph benchmark with attributed-graph protocol v2. Cases now carry supplied weighted relations, positions, mixed attributes, overlap/private-node truth, row identities, perturbation severity, train/dev/final roles, and content hashes. Twelve development cases and 42 zero-tuning final cases are frozen in installed manifests. The 30 final accuracy/robustness cases include both partial-overlap and closed-world regimes so classic comparators are not judged only on an unsupported task.
  • Added raw-attribute, position, topology-descriptor, anchor, row-identity, source-only and target-only classification, and chance controls. Benchmark rows now record typed outcomes and whether supplied topology was actually consumed; RAPID-MA is the supplied-graph comparator in the interactive dispatcher.
  • Normalized package comparator adapters through the canonical method registry. Supplied-edge mutations now affect only RAPID-MA inputs; feature-derived and metric-measure methods are labeled accordingly, unsupported topology is rejected before execution, and prediction records preserve row identities plus anchor/non-anchor/private partitions. Frozen search-space hashes, equal tier wall-clock ceilings, convergence, timeout, and external peak-RSS status are carried in every result row. LSE is explicitly unsupported for cross-domain scoring, and LeMA remains an unavailable external reference until a reproducible adapter exists.
  • Vectorized v2 edge canonicalization so large sparse scenario generation no longer performs one data-frame assembly per unique edge.
  • Added governed real-data protocol 1.0 with checksum-pinned So2Sat-LCZ42, AUCS, and Sampson monastery tasks. Real network cases preserve observed direction, edge weights, natural partial overlap, unequal active-node sets, hidden scoring identities, and deterministic training anchors. Remote- sensing cases expose separate fit and scorer views so testing-east labels cannot enter fitting.
  • Added resumable, license-gated acquisition, deterministic real-patch feature extraction, a small schema-only CI fixture, and a full frozen-split runner. Evidence rows distinguish unavailable or invalid datasets from algorithm failures and label CI accuracy as non-ranking diagnostics.
  • Added the frozen package-wide alignment tournament: 588 typed rows over 42 cases and 14 methods, with external runtime/peak-RSS measurement, resumable checkpoints, survivor-bias-safe summaries, paired effects, Pareto fronts, controls, and recursive checksums. RAPID-MA completed every case and is the only comparator that consumed supplied weighted relations, but its matching remains below the position-only control in every non-oracle regime. Its classification probe beats source-only transfer in every non-oracle regime; neither result is presented as a universal winner claim. See the checked interpretation and raw receipt.

Documentation

  • Updated FPGW documentation to distinguish metric-measure geometry from observed graph topology and to make rho the sole partial-transport API.

Testing

  • Added a dependency-independent FPGW oracle that exhaustively enumerates tiny weighted transport flows and checks compiled optimality, the independent four-index objective, exact mass and capacities, fusion endpoints, monotone objective traces, and target-permutation equivariance. The former balanced-mass lambda behavior is retained only as a rejection regression.
  • Replaced KEMA completion-only and tautological solver tests with independent generalized-eigen oracles, hard failure-path checks, semi-supervised null-space coverage, and full/reduced/operator subspace agreement tests.
  • Added graph-v2 generator-truth, common-random-severity, manifest-hash, no-final-tuning, negative-control, and observed-topology dispatch tests.
  • Added real-data provenance, checksum, row/edge identity, weighted/directed topology, leakage, deterministic-control, and typed-failure tests. The enforced alignment matrix now names the governed real-data fixture and its CI-versus-release evidence scopes.
  • Made ALIGNMENT_TEST_MATRIX.yml an enforced 22-method computational-test contract. PR, nightly, and release runners now report failures, warnings, skips, mandatory-oracle status, known gaps, and release availability by method and severity. Mandatory skips fail CI, stable promotion requires all computational families, and a dependency-independent coupled-diagonalization finite-difference oracle replaces optional-package-only evidence.
  • Added tournament meta-tests for exact method-case coverage, denominator-correct missing predictions, semantic versus resource applicability, per-adapter tiny oracles, target-permutation invariance, typed errors, checkpoint resumption, and checksum-complete final evidence.
